note: Machine-readable release acceptance. Every entry is PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN|BLOCKED with a relative log path, expected/actual result, hardware, and start/end times. The release may only be signed 'all S5 passed' when every entry is PASS (no FAIL / NOT_RUN / BLOCKED).
environmentLimits: Windows symbolic links are unavailable because Developer Mode is off (HKLM AppModelUnlock AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense unset), so the S4 checklist-contract anti-case link_cases reports NOT_RUN rather than passing; docs/S4-状态.md already records this. Re-running S4 with Developer Mode enabled or elevated privileges is the only way to obtain that evidence.
evidenceNote: Log paths named here are the live locations that regenerate on each run; earlier runs' per-run logs under build/ were overwritten by later --rerun-tasks invocations, so no entry cites a file that no longer exists. Durable copies of the long-run evidence (505-owner traversal, fault matrices) live under docs/evidence/. Statuses below were set on 2026-10-07 from runs executed in this workspace. An entry is PASS only where the exact expected condition was observed; partial coverage stays NOT_RUN with the gap named in `actual`. JUnit 562/562 and the 5-source-set compile are prerequisites, not acceptance entries.

acceptance.title: dedicated server + client: core only / FTB absent+present / Road absent+patched / Tectonic / C2ME CPU / fullpack OpenCL
acceptance.expected: each profile verified; unauthenticated C2ME hooks refuse generation; OpenCL menu is not worldgen
acceptance.actual: Only the vanilla profile was executed. Investigating why the others are not automatable: the smoke run loads exactly three jars (fabric-api, the mod, the smoke harness) and `smokeProfile` only changes the run directory, the expectedAdapter property, the heap size and -Dgreatwall.smoke.profile. It does NOT add Tectonic, C2ME or the OpenCL pack to the classpath, so passing -PsmokeProfile=tectonic would produce a run labelled tectonic while loading the same three jars. The Tectonic and full-pack OpenCL rows of this entry therefore cannot be satisfied by this harness and require the user's real instance. The C2ME row is reachable only via the disableRewrite path, which is restricted to the tectonic-c2me profile and was not exercised.

acceptance.title: 24h stress / far-jump / Chunky corridor / CPU-GPU matrix / slice timing observed (no hard 40ms gate) / heap plateau
acceptance.expected: every performance gate PASS with real data; slice timing is recorded and reported, but a slow batch caused by other mods competing for CPU does not fail the release
acceptance.actual: A 1-hour MIXED_24H profile PASSED with real data (72000 ticks, 52320 chunks, 121 checkpoints, peak heap 7.99/8GB, passed=true). The 24h run is in progress; two earlier attempts failed and each exposed a real defect: a drain timeout judged a completed profile as failed, and an inFlightFutures leak exhausted the heap so a chunk-save tick tripped the 60s watchdog 14 minutes after the first refill. It stays NOT_RUN until a 24h run reports passed=true with durationMet=true.

acceptance.title: 18 fault points x {exception,halt} x 10 rounds recovery
acceptance.expected: per-matrix exact results; corrupt CRC never truncated
acceptance.actual: exception: 180/180 passed=true, exit code 1 on every run. halt: 180/180 passed=true, exit code 137 on every run. 18 points x 10 rounds per mode, evidence in docs/evidence/s5/. Scope note: per docs/S5.md:24 this entry requires the per-point injection rounds and exit codes, which is what was run; FaultProcessMain starts no server and generates no world. The recovery half is covered elsewhere (HistoryJournalTest.completeBadCrcIsNotTruncated asserts the corrupt bytes are not truncated and the file is byte-identical afterwards; partialTailIsArchivedReadOnlyBeforeForcedTruncate, failedFsyncNeverPublishesAndVerifiedRetryReusesActualTail, checkpointFailureLeavesOriginalHeadAndRecoveryCanContinue, missingHeadRecoversOnlyAConsistentRetainedChain, damagedIndexMissingWalAndWrongWorldNeverBecomeEmpty, plus RecoveryCoordinatorTest). Note that RecoveryTest.eachFaultPointReopensWithoutSilentReset is narrower than its name: it checks enum round-trip, that a throwing injector aborts, and fault-hit.json path confinement, not an actual crash-and-reopen at each point. Reaching this required fixing three driver defects: the witness file was written to the shared root instead of the per-run directory, the Gradle task's ignoreExitValue hid the child's real status so every point scored as failed, and the per-run directory was not keyed by mode so halt runs collided with exception runs.

acceptance.title: road-before-wall / shared-cell / protected-gap gate negotiation
acceptance.expected: same frozen gate transaction; no wider hole; no third-party block chiseling
acceptance.log: build/reports/gametest/ (rebuilt on each full run; see evidenceNote)
acceptance.actual: NegotiatedGateGameTests covers roadBeforeWallUsesSameFrozenGate, differentRoadsShareNegotiatedCell and noCandidatePreservesProtectedGap; GateFreezeSolverTest and RoadWeaverAllowlistTest cover the solver and the interop allowlist. All passed in the full run. The missing GateFreezeSolver was itself a real defect found during red-teaming (M3). Supporting coverage added 2026-10-07: WallObstacleGeometryTest pins the continuous XZ geometry that decides whether a road may pass a wall (long edges and sparse polylines cannot skip an obstacle), and SiteRuntimeIndexGameTests pins the index every spawn query reads. Neither had any test before.

acceptance.title: strict offline clean build + runGameTest + verifyReleaseArtifacts
acceptance.actual: runGameTest is green: 'All 119 required tests passed' in 3h22m, from a re-run after the baseline was invalidated. verifyReleaseArtifacts still FAILs on the version string only, as recorded under version-lock. The strict-offline half passed on 2026-09-29: 'remapJar remapSourcesJar --offline --dependency-verification=strict --rerun-tasks' succeeded with compileJava actually re-executing, recorded in docs/evidence/s0-01/metadata-repair/offline-build-strict-rerun.txt. That evidence predates corridorHalfWidth 192->512 and every change this session, so it shows the offline path works rather than certifying the current source; Test-S5Release.ps1 re-exercises it with the same flags, and produced the identical SHA 80506fe57a6379b151ef3dab4ce7b83ec62b5ad74e631d0049777f5c4d08f456. The entry stays FAIL only because of the version string, which is the same blocker as version-lock and is cleared by bumping the version at release time. Note that `clean` could not be included in the offline run because the 24h stress profile holds open files under build/; a delete-and-rebuild of build/libs was verified separately as reproducible-build.
